data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: task-execution.md invokes visual-evaluator after sub-agent implementation, routes by attribution_class
- dd-2: iteration_cap=2 and intent_match threshold=3 honored, independent of review.max_cycles
- dd-3: intent_match below threshold blocks task closure; quality-dim shortfalls → visual_debt:<dim> annotation
- dd-4: visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale surfaced prominently when skill emits it
- dd-5: Regression tests for 3 scenarios

## Implementation Notes
Add visual-evaluator invocation section to plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md (or equivalent file in the skill). Document:

1. Post-implementation hook: invoke /dso:visual-evaluator skill on each task touching UI files
2. Attribution routing: implementation_drift @ high/med → re-prompt sub-agent; design_flaw @ high/med → re-dispatch /dso:ui-designer; mixed|uncertain|low → user dialog (or INTERACTIVITY_DEFERRED in non-interactive)
3. iteration_cap = 2 (configurable via visual_evaluator.iteration_cap)
4. intent_match threshold = 3 default (configurable via visual_evaluator.iteration_threshold)
5. Failure mode: intent_match < threshold blocks closure; quality dimensions < threshold → ticket annotated visual_debt:<dimension> and proceed
6. iteration_cap is independent of review.max_cycles — documented inline
7. When skill emits visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_stale, surface prominently to the user
8. dso-config.conf entries documented in section

Tests in tests/skills/test-sprint-task-execution-visual-eval.sh:
- test_sustained_intent_match_drift_fails_closure (2 iterations exhausted with intent_match<3 → block)
- test_quality_dim_shortfall_visual_debt_annotated (intent_match>=3 but other dim<3 → visual_debt added, closure proceeds)
- test_mixed_uncertain_findings_auto_defer (3 mixed findings → auto-defer after 2nd user dialog)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] task-execution.md (or equivalent) includes visual-evaluator section with attribution routing
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md
- [ ] iteration_cap and iteration_threshold documented
  Verify: grep -q 'iteration_cap' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md && grep -q 'iteration_threshold' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md
- [ ] All 3 regression tests pass
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-sprint-task-execution-visual-eval.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
